resources.string:
For something done step by step while following the screen: a workout, a recipe, stretching. Each step ends on a timer or on “Done”, with a sound, a vibration or a voice at each change.
## What it does
- Its own schedule: at each planned time, a notification and a session ready
- Each session done is kept, with its duration and the steps done or skipped
- A planned session never done shows as missed
## Not made for
- A reminder with nothing to follow (Messages)
- A value noted alone (Tracking)

## The steps
Each element is a step or a block. A step has a name and an instruction, shown during the step and read aloud (“10 × 60 kg”), and Images, shown during the step too, the first one large (a posture, a dish). It ends in three ways:
- On the timer: the next step starts by itself
- By hand: a stopwatch runs until you touch “Done”
- On the timer, then by hand: the timer rings, and the stopwatch goes on until “Done”

## The blocks
A block repeats its steps a number of rounds.
- Skipped at the last round: the step is not done in the block's last round, like a rest with nothing left after it

## The signals
- At each change of step: sound and vibration, sound only, vibration only, or nothing
- Countdown: a beep at 3, 2 and 1 second before a timed step ends
- Voice: says the step that begins and its instruction

## The planning
- Planned sessions: at the times chosen, each with its notification
- Notify: unchecked, the sessions are planned without a notification
- On: unchecked, no session is planned any more
- Expires: when a session planned and never started expires — never, at the next one (one alone is then left planned), or after a delay; one started and not finished waits

## Before
- Start: begins the session, after a “Get ready”
For a planned session waiting:
- Done: you did it without following the screen
- Ignore: it does not count
- Ignore all: for those that piled up during an absence

## During
- Pause, then Resume
- Done: ends the step by hand
- Skip: skips the step
- Back: goes back to the step before
- +15 s: makes the timer longer
- Restart the step
- {square} Stop: the steps not yet reached stay not done
If the app closes during a session, the session resumes at its step, and the time gone by counts as a pause.

## After
- Finish the session: under your fields if the tool has some; until then the session waits, and another cannot start
Each session is kept in the history, with its duration and its steps. Touch a session to correct its steps (done, skipped, not reached) and your fields.
Steps prepared ahead, then followed on screen with a timer and a signal at each change, such as a workout or a recipe
Whether it is a step or a block
How many times the block\'s steps are done in a row
Shown during the step, and said by the voice when it is on (“10 × 60 kg”, “Meanwhile: the sauce”)
Shown during the step, the first one large (a posture, a dish): images, the tool\'s own or the field of an entry followed
Played during the step, a sound with the screen off, a video on the session\'s screen: one audio or video file, the tool\'s own or the field of an entry followed
How long the step lasts: none, no time of its own; fixed, the duration written; media, its sound or video\'s
No time of its own: a stopwatch counts up until “Done”
The length of its sound or video; with nothing to play, a stopwatch until “Done”
At the end of its time, the next step comes by itself; otherwise the stopwatch goes on in overtime until “Done”. Never with no time of its own
The step “%1$s” has no time of its own: nothing would end it by itself. Give it a time, or untick Next step by itself.
Left out of the block\'s last round: the rest that comes before nothing
The signal when a step begins: sound_and_vibration, sound, vibration or none
A beep at 3, 2 and 1 second before a timed step ends
Says the step that begins and its instruction
Switched off, no session is planned
planned, running, to_finish (over, waiting for “Finish the session”), done, stopped, ignored or expired (planned, never started, past the sequence\'s expiry)
The session running as the app follows it; gone once it is over
How long the session lasted, its pauses left out
How long the session was paused
The steps a session stopped on the way did not reach
A planned session left undone, which stays in the history
Every planned session of the tool left undone
Starting a session and its gestures belong to whoever does it
This session is over and waits to be finished: touch “Finish the session”
A session is over and waits to be finished: %1$s
This session does not wait to be finished
This session is not a planned one
Stop the session? The steps not reached stay not done.
This session was stopped with the app. Resume it: its step starts again, the time since counted as a pause.
The timer ran out: “Done”, or start the step again
Session over: touch to finish it
The planned session done; left out for a session that was not planned
When it was done: required for a session that was not planned; for a planned one, its planned time when left out
How long it lasted, if known
Marks a session done without following the screen, all its steps counted done: a planned one (id), or one that was not planned, at the time given

Corrects a session over: its time, its length, and the state of each step (step_statuses) for a session that keeps its steps, its steps done, skipped and not reached for another, each value kept when left out; the counts add up to the session\'s steps, and its state follows them
A session that was not planned needs the time it was done
Only a session over can be corrected
The steps done, skipped and not reached must add up to %1$d, the session\'s steps; they add up to %2$d
A count of steps cannot be below zero
Done, skipped and not reached add up to %1$d steps
A session is not created directly: mark one done with the operation complete (TOOL_OPERATION), a planned one or one at the time given; the app plans the others.

The session\'s steps as they ran, copied when it ended: a JSON list, each with name, status (done, skipped, not_done) and time, its time in milliseconds, absent for a step not reached or a session noted without the screen
For a session that keeps its steps: the state of each, in order, as many as there are steps; the counts follow from them
This session keeps its steps: correct it with step_statuses, the state of each step, not with its counts
step_statuses gives the state of each step, in order: %1$d states, each done, skipped or not_done
This session does not keep its steps, finished before they were kept: correct its counts
When the session started, or its planned time
How the session went, written by the app when it ends: its duration, its pauses, its steps done, skipped or not done
The user\'s fields, filled in when a session is finished, such as how it went or the effort felt
Where the session stands: planned, running, to finish, done, stopped or ignored; its start and end, and while it runs, its course
A step, followed on the screen, or a block of steps repeated
The block\'s steps, in order, done again at each round
A step of the block, or a block inside it
One step, followed on the screen until it ends
Steps done again several rounds in a row; a block inside a block holds steps only
The block\'s name, shown while it runs
The step\'s name, shown while it runs and kept in the history
The time the timer counts down
Steps done, for a session that does not keep its steps
Steps skipped, for a session that does not keep its steps
Steps not reached, for a session that does not keep its steps
The state of each step, in order
A notification at each planned session
Plans a session now, beside the schedule: an entry planned dated now, its notification and its event as a scheduled session's
